_meta.note: Hand-curated, approximate shelf-life guidance (days), drawn from typical USDA FoodSafety.gov storage guidance for each item's common raw/generic form. Keys (item_name) are the exact normalized ingredient name strings produced by mealsight.matching.normalize.normalize_ingredient, chosen to cover the proteins, vegetables, fruits, dairy, grains, and condiments that actually appear in the seeded recipe corpus and in the vision-model vocabulary (see mealsight.seed.vision_vocabulary). shelf_days_refrigerated/frozen/pantry are null wherever that storage mode genuinely doesn't apply (e.g. eggs are not typically frozen whole; salt has no real pantry shelf-life limit at all — represented here as a very large number instead of null, since it IS pantry-storable, just effectively indefinitely). These are approximations for relative comparison (estimating whether an item is getting old), not food-safety-certified expiration dates.
